Inside Macintosh: What's New in Advanced Color Imaging on the Mac OS/
Changes by Chapter

Advanced Color Imaging Reference

All chapters feature a revised format that includes additional hypertext cross-references for more effective online viewing. This section gives a brief description of specific changes to each chapter.

Preface, "About This Book"

The preface provides a description of the content and format of the advanced color imaging books.

Chapter 1, "Palette Manager Reference"

The section "ActivatePalette" contains additional information on calling the ActivatePalette function with an offscreen graphics world.

Chapter 2, "Color Picker Manager Reference"

No significant content changes.

Chapter 3, "ColorSync Manager Reference for Applications and Device Drivers"

Substantially rewritten to describe new and revised constants, data types, and functions added for version 2.1 of the ColorSync Manager. Includes several new illustrations.

For additional information and hypertext links to changed material in this chapter, see the section "ColorSync 2.1" in this document.

Chapter 4, "ColorSync Manager Reference for Color Management Modules"

Describes new and revised constants, data types, and functions added for support of named color spaces.

For additional information and hypertext links to changed material in this chapter, see the section "ColorSync 2.1" in this document.

Chapter 5, "Color Manager Reference"

No significant content changes.
